name: @gjsify/node-runtime-darwin-x64
description: Bundled Node.js interpreter for macOS on Intel — just the `node` binary from a pinned Node 24 LTS release plus its LICENSE, for apps that `gjsify ship` packages where no system Node can be assumed. Platform-gated (darwin/x64 only). Node.js is a registered trademark of the OpenJS Foundation; this package is not affiliated with, endorsed, or sponsored by the OpenJS Foundation.
